Terry falls victim to Walter White in "Breaking Bad," and Terry and Larry test three separate scenes from this series, two of which need the help of special effects artist Andre Ellington.

Pete Heat checks out some of the trendiest bars in Mumbai, meets a famous Bollywood artist and shows you how to perform your own piece of magic at home.

title: Space Greed
description:
S01 E04 — Carbon Costs: Is Space Exploration Even Worth It?
There are only a handful of rocket launches every year, but that could change; each rocket that gets fired off has an impact on the atmosphere; Earth may not be able to survive hundreds, or even thousands, of fuel-burning rocket launches every year.

title: Space Greed
description:
S01 E05 — Looting the Moon for Trillions of Dollars
The moon is rich in rare earths, metals, and the highly sought-after isotope Helium 3; with NASA planning to make a manned return trip to the moon by 2024, some giant corporation could turn moon dust into a cosmic-sized payday.

title: Space Greed
description:
S01 E06 — Asteroid Mining: Is the Next Gold Rush in Space?
Running out of crucial resources and materials is only a matter of time; the asteroids flying through the solar system contain tons of precious metals, stones, and more; the astronomical profits from mining asteroids could all hype.

title: Health Explored
description:
S02 E02 — Norway - Friluftsliv (Open Air Life) Part II
We go sea to summit with a skiing experience; we trek to an unskied peak then go diving in the frozen ocean; then we learn about sauna culture and how activity should be fun not work.

title: Health Explored
description:
S02 E03 — Morocco - Sands of Time Part I
On Morocco's coast, initiatives combine education, play and sustainability to raise environmental awareness; the Clean and Play program encourages children to clean beaches in exchange for fun activities; recycling also creates jobs for marginalize.

title: Health Explored
description:
S02 E04 — Sahara - Sands of Time Part II
We trek into the Sahara for an overnight camp and then visit the nomads; we learn how climate change is impacting life in the desert and why time should be valued.

S01 E06 — Vanilla: The Bean That Shaped the Future of Food
In 1841 on the small island of Réunion, a 12-year-old slave did something no one had done before; the vanilla bean takes the world by storm, sparking the artificial flavor revolution and forever changing how we eat.

title: The Re-Inventors
description:
Human Propulsion
Matt and Jeremy combine machines with muscle and add some rockets, propellers, and jets into the mix.

title: The Re-Inventors
description:
Invention War
Matt and Jeremy modify a number of their previous inventions and pit them against one another in a bizarre battle scenario.

title: The Re-Inventors
description:
Snow Annihilator
The inventor of the Snow Annihilator claims the machine has all the answers to winter road maintenance and is tested against the Canadian winter.

title: The Ultimates
description:
S01 E04 — Ultimate Strike Planes
Take a look at the history of creating stronger, faster and more powerful military aircraft.

title: The Chain: How The World Works
description:
S01 E01 — Food
At the World Food Championships, a $5 burger reveals a massive global chain of space-visible greenhouses, cow rearing, and historic ketchup.

title: The Chain: How The World Works
description:
S01 E02 — Transport
At a Formula-E race in Chile, we uncover how tree sap, pink lithium lakes, molten rock and top-secret paint create cutting-edge electric cars.

title: The Chain: How The World Works
description:
S01 E03 — Sport
Inside LA's SoFi Stadium, a touchdown is made possible by Chinese rare earths, plastic grass, specialized ball factories, and fizzy sodas.

title: The Chain: How The World Works
description:
S01 E04 — Apparel
At a massive secondhand market in Ghana, the global fashion chain is traced through high-water cotton, stretchy oil denim and bug-made silk.

title: The Chain: How The World Works
description:
S01 E05 — Healthcare
Inside a Boston maternity ward, the complex medical chain reveals how flowers become painkillers and one Pakistani town shapes global surgery.

title: The Chain: How The World Works
description:
S01 E06 — Communications
The New York City Marathon highlights our connected world, driven by 62-metal smartphones, microscopic microchips, and billion-dollar cloud bunkers.

title: The Re-Inventors
description:
Floatation Suit
Inventions ranging from shoes to suits that can help you from drowning.

title: The Re-Inventors
description:
Head Parachute
Getting people out of a burning building has been a challenge faced by inventors and designers since people started living in them.

title: The Re-Inventors
description:
Gun Helmet
A World War I era helmet gun is built to see who would be in more danger, the user or the target.

title: Silly Sustainability
description:
S01 E02 — Cardboard Lumber Part 1
Andy from "@How To Make Everything" explores if household recyclables can be turned into a lumber substitute.
